reference.capture: live tmux input with stable screen capture and sanitized HERMES_HOME history-file readback

normalization: Temporary checkout and synthetic HERMES_HOME paths are represented by placeholders.
Timestamps, session IDs, elapsed seconds, rotating prompt suggestions, and dynamic working-directory text are omitted or represented by placeholders.
History-file samples preserve semantic line bytes while replacing the generated timestamp comment with <timestamp>.
Input bytes are recorded in hexadecimal after tmux key translation; repeated key probes record one representative event plus an explicit repeat count.
The fixture contains no credentials, provider responses, model payloads, or private Hermes state.

steps.precondition: Fresh synthetic HERMES_HOME with a configured loopback custom provider and no existing .hermes_history.

output.status: ready after an interrupted busy turn
output.history_effect: the submitted text is persisted for a later process

steps.precondition: The first TUI process has exited cleanly; a second process uses the same HERMES_HOME.
The second process submits the same text again after the persisted entry is already the newest entry.
Fresh synthetic HERMES_HOME with the same loopback custom provider; the draft is inserted through one bracketed paste event.

output.encoding: each logical line is stored with a leading plus marker and reconstructed with a newline

steps.precondition: A sanitized history file contains exactly 1001 entries named cap-0001 through cap-1001 before process launch.

output.effect: the oldest retained entry is the second entry from the 1001-entry seed
history navigation remains at the oldest retained entry

unknowns: History-file write failures, malformed lines, and concurrent writers were not exercised.
Non-consecutive duplicate entries, explicit history clearing, and history behavior across profile migration remain unobserved.
The cap was verified at load/navigation time; file compaction or physical truncation after appending beyond 1000 entries was not exercised.
This observation does not claim Hades implementation parity; it only records the Hermes reference contract.
